jobs.title: FTC Compliance Analyst
jobs.description:
The Aerospace Corporation is the trusted partner to the nation’s space programs, solving the hardest problems and providing unmatched technical expertise. As the operator of a federally funded research and development center (FFRDC), we are broadly engaged across all aspects of space— delivering innovative solutions that span satellite, launch, ground, and cyber systems for defense, civil and commercial customers. When you join our team, you’ll be part of a special collection of problem solvers, thought leaders, and innovators. Join us and take your place in space.

Building on The Aerospace Corporation's reputation as a trusted, impartial advisor with integrity and dedication to mission success, the Civil Systems Group (CSG) combines deep technical expertise with market-leading innovation to help our customers solve complex systems engineering and integration challenges. CSG is organized by core customer-facing lines of business to manage and grow programs within NASA, NOAA, and the NNSA, while extending our capabilities to other civilian federal government agencies fully integrated within Aerospace rules, regulations, processes, values, and behaviors.

  

As the **FTC Compliance Analyst (Senior Project Engineer - Systems Engineering - Acquisition),** you will provide direct, full-time support to the U.S. Government–appointed Compliance Officer (CO) to assist in the execution of responsibilities ensuring Boeing’s adherence to non-discriminatory practices and data protection requirements arising from its acquisition of Spirit. This role plays a critical part in monitoring, assessing, and verifying compliance with the Federal Trade Commission (FTC) Consent Order authorizing the acquisition.

  

The selected candidate will develop deep expertise in the FTC Consent Order and work closely with mid-level government officials, regulators, and industry partners to interpret, communicate, implement, and execute the Compliance Officer’s responsibilities in a highly regulated environment.

  

**The selected candidate will be required to work full-time, on-site at our facility in Chantilly, VA or El Segundo, CA.**

  

**What You’ll Be Doing**

* Serve as the Aerospace Government Compliance Team (GCT) lead responsible for developing internal requirements and overseeing the evaluation and verification of Northrop Grumman’s non-discrimination and data protection practices against FTC Consent Order requirements.
* Act as a primary interface between Aerospace, Boeing, and government oversight organizations, including the Defense Contract Management Agency (DCMA) and Defense Contract Audit Agency (DCAA).
* Support interactions, as needed U.S. Government agencies on compliance-related matters.
* Develop and manage information requests, compliance processes, and procedural frameworks to ensure consistent, auditable execution of Consent Order obligations.
* Support budgeting, resource planning, and allocation activities required to execute compliance tasks in coordination with the Systems Director.
* Analyze compliance findings, identify gaps or risks, and prepare clear, well-documented reports and briefings for the Compliance Officer, Systems Director, and relevant Government stakeholders.
* Support audits, reviews, and inquiries by coordinating data collection, validating evidence, and ensuring timely, accurate responses in alignment with Consent Order and Government requirements.
* Conduct site visits and travel to user community locations and Boeing facilities, including Wichita, KS; and other locations, as required, to perform compliance verification and oversight activities.
  

**What You Need to be Successful- FTC Compliance Analyst (Senior Project Engineer - Systems Engineering - Acquisition)**

*Minimum Requirements:*

* Bachelors degree in hard sciences such as Chemistry, Math, Engineering, Physics, or a related STEM field—to provide a robust interdisciplinary foundation.
* A minimum of 10 or more years of increasingly responsible and relevant professional experience in military systems acquisitions, contracts and/or compliance is required.
* Background in and understanding of military aircraft systems strategy and/or policy
* Applicants must perform well both independently and as a team member, effectively coordinate multiple diverse activities, possess excellent teaching and interpersonal skills, and demonstrate superior oral and written communications abilities.
* This position requires a current and active or be eligible to reapply for a TS/SCI security clearance, which is issued by the U.S. government. U.S. citizenship is required to obtain a security clearance.
  

**How You Can Stand Out**

*It would be impressive if you have one or more of these:*

* Advanced degree in hard science is preferred including operational experience.
* More than 10 years practical experience in developing, implementing, evaluating, and refining compliance and training programs and must be able to tailor innovative and responsive applications of these capabilities to specific order requirements.
* Previous experience working with the U.S. government is strongly preferred.
* Current and active TS/SCI clearance
  

We offer a competitive compensation package where you’ll be rewarded based on your performance and recognized for the value you bring to our business. jobs.title: Research Grants Analyst
jobs.description:
The Research Grants Analyst works in Schmid College and supports faculty from the natural sciences at Schmid College on proposal preparation to various sponsors. Works with principal investigators, faculty and staff to coordinate pre- and post-award activities for grants and/or contracts. Assists with grant development activities including proposal and budget preparation and review. Provides guidance on funding agency regulations, as well as Chapman University’s administrative and fiscal policies. Assists with non-financial post award actions such as progress reports, re-budgeting, no-cost extension, and other prior approval requests, etc. Other duties as assigned including data entry, reconciling accounts and general administrative support. Additionally, this position may work with Sponsored Projects Services (SPS) leadership and staff. Schmid is part of the growing success of Chapman University, which recently achieved R2 status in 2019 by Carnegie Classification of Institutions of Higher Education. This places the university in the top 10% of research universities in the country. More importantly, it means a growing profile of basic and applied research with international reach.
  
  
Chapman University’s mission is centered on serving our students and strengthening our campus community. Chapman believes there is significant value in an in-person workforce. Being present fosters collaboration, strengthens relationships across departments, enables us to better serve our co-workers and contributes to the student experience. It is an important part of the culture that makes Chapman a special place to work and learn.

* Work closely with university departments to reconcile and resolve budgetary matters.

**Job description**

**JOB SUMMARY**:

The **Buyer Planner** will plan, release and manage production work orders and purchase orders to fulfill production requirements. Position will also be responsible for monitoring and managing assigned value streams and planner codes including inventory and customer service levels. Will also be responsible for planning finished goods inventory levels for distribution.

  
  

*The selected candidate must reside within a commutable distance to Pomona, CA. This is not a hybrid or remote opportunity and requires onsite presence 5 days per week.*

  
  

**PRIMARY DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Releases and manages production requisitions in accordance with heijunka level loading, kanban signals, production plan goals and related planning data.
* Places and manages purchases orders in accordance with MRP, Kanban signals, production plan goals and related planning data.
* Works closely with manufacturing and suppliers to prioritize, expedite and de-expedite work orders and purchase orders based on material availability, department resources, changing requirements and customer service requirements.
* Manage the assigned value streams including the management of inventory turns improvement, backorder reduction and coordinating activities with other planner buyers and departments.
* Participates in the new product development process and supports supply chain planning activities at the new product team level.
* Manage, monitor and update kanbans for assigned value streams and production cells.
* Have strong working knowledge and apply the principles of planning/pull system.
* Have an understanding of lean manufacturing and a continuous improvement focus.
* Manage and maintain inventory levels to the company goals at the raw, sub-assembly, WIP and finished good levels.
* Monitors and understands key planning parameters such as lead-time, safety stocks, buffer stocks and lot sizes.
* Works closely with suppliers to manage and control material supply, to prioritize, expedite and assure enough material supply to fulfill customer demand.

**Job requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree (B.S.) in Business, Supply Chain, or Operations and 1+ year of work-related experience in a manufacturing environment; production planning or purchasing **OR**
* High school diploma and 5+ years of work experience in purchasing, planning, supply chain, materials management, or manufacturing operations.
* Experience working within ERP systems such as Oracle, SAP, or equivalent.
* Possess excellent communication (technical, oral, written) and the ability to describe issues clearly.
* Excellent computer skills and solid in Microsoft Office Suite applications, i.e. Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, Copilot, Project are required.
  

  

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:**

* APICS Certification a plus.
* Strong interpersonal skills that create effective cross functional relationships in a high performing environment.
* Driven and motivated individual with demonstrated critical thinking and analytical skills.
* Unquestionably high ethical standards and attention to reputational and compliance risks.
* Organized thinker that can prioritize tasks in real time and exercise judgment in high-paced environment.
* Ability to calculate rates, ratios, and percent to draw and interpret graphs.
* Ability to discern trends and analyze operational and financial reports.
* Ability to apply common sense understanding to carry out detailed written or oral instructions.
* Possess excellent technical judgment and able to set logical action plan and technical problem resolution.

jobs.description:
**About Us**

Join a team that helps deliver products that make a meaningful difference in people's lives.

We are a fast-growing manufacturer serving the medical device industry, where quality, innovation, and reliability are at the core of everything we do. Our products support critical healthcare applications and are trusted by leading customers around the world.

As part of our Supply Chain team, you'll gain firsthand experience in how materials, suppliers, manufacturing, and customer demand come together to produce life-changing products. This role offers a unique opportunity to develop valuable skills in procurement, planning, inventory management, supplier relations, and manufacturing operations while working alongside experienced professionals.

This position provides a strong foundation for growth into Supply Chain, Procurement, Operations, Production Planning, Strategic Sourcing, or Materials Management leadership roles.

* Plan and purchase raw materials, components, packaging, labeling, and finished goods to support manufacturing operations.
* Use ERP and MRP systems to ensure material availability and optimize inventory levels.
* Create and manage purchase orders and production job orders.
* Monitor supplier performance and coordinate delivery schedules to support customer commitments.
* Communicate with suppliers to resolve shortages, expedite critical materials, and maintain continuity of supply.
* Partner with Production, Quality, Engineering, Customer Service, and Operations teams to support manufacturing goals.
* Analyze inventory levels and help establish reorder points and stocking strategies.
* Identify cost savings, sourcing opportunities, and process improvements.
* Track material movement from receiving and inspection through inventory availability.
* Maintain accurate purchasing and planning data within company systems.
* Participate in supply chain improvement projects and cross-functional initiatives.

**What we’re looking for:**

* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Excellent communication and relationship-building abilities.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
* Comfortable working with data, spreadsheets, and business systems.
* Positive attitude, curiosity, and willingness to learn.
* Ability to work effectively within cross-functional teams.

  

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 0-2 years of experience in purchasing, planning, manufacturing, operations, customer service, or related business environments. This may include internships, co-ops, or academic project experience.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Excel and other Microsoft Office applications.
* Experience with ERP systems such as Made2Manage (M2M), Epicor, SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics, or similar business systems is a plus.
* Interest in pursuing professional supply chain certifications such as APICS/ASCM CPIM or CSCP is encouraged.

We recognize that strong candidates may not meet every qualification listed above. If you are motivated to learn, enjoy solving problems, and are interested in building a career in supply chain and manufacturing, we encourage you to apply.

**What You'll Gain**

* Exposure to all facets of supply chain and manufacturing operations.
* Hands-on experience with procurement, production planning, inventory management, and supplier management.
* Training on ERP and MRP systems used in a regulated manufacturing environment.
* Opportunities to develop negotiation, analytical, and project management skills.
* Career growth potential within Supply Chain, Procurement, Planning, Operations, and Leadership positions.
* The opportunity to contribute to products that support critical healthcare and medical applications.

**Success in This Role**

Successful Buyer/Planners help ensure materials are available when needed, inventory is effectively managed, suppliers perform reliably, and customer commitments are met. Their work directly supports operational excellence and customer satisfaction while contributing to the growth and success of the organization.

Assignments are both task oriented and objective oriented. Follows established procedures for routine work and receives specific instruction for non-routine work.

No current subordinates. Position requires the use of judgment to plan and perform. General decisions are made to solve a problem or select a course of action for a standard or recognized method of operation.

Uses critical thinking skills to create original documents, reports and spreadsheets and interpret information furnished in written, oral or schedule form; able to make set goals based on available information and to plan work in order to meet deadlines; able to be resourceful at problem solving and formulates appropriate responses to requests for services and information from internal or external customers; able to project likely future occurrences based on current or historic data.

jobs.title: Accounting Analyst (Associate Development Program)
jobs.description:
Monthend is the most tech forward and “tech enabled” construction accounting & technology firm in the U.S. We are growing very fast, making this an opportunity to be part of something awesome.

We are looking for an energetic Accounting Analyst to support and expand our accounting services and technology offerings. Monthend focuses on the accounting and software needs of builders, remodelers, and commercial contractors. You will start as an analyst; as you develop skills, you will advance - into a small business consultant.

This role is intentionally designed as a launch point for accelerated career growth within Monthend.

This is a full-time position.

**In this position, you will:**

* Work with the Monthend team to manage day-to-day transactions for our clients using Monthend proprietary technology along with QuickBooks Online, Buildertrend, and a variety of other construction management and software tools. You will work across multiple systems and learn how data flows between them.
* Process customer source documents (paperless) by reviewing data for deficiencies. This work goes beyond data entry and requires attention to detail, judgment, and problem-solving.
* Resolve deficiencies by using standard procedures or by communicating with the client for resolution
* Enter and create financial records and transactions, and validatethe accuracy of records across multiple platforms while learning how transactional accuracy supports higher-level financial reporting and advisory work.
* Support Associates and Managers in a variety of tasks and progressively take on more complex responsibilities as your skills develop.
* Generate reports for clients and Monthend management and learn how those reports are used to help clients make better business decisions.
* Demonstrate growth in accounting judgment, system fluency, and client understanding over time, with clear opportunities to advance into senior accounting and advisory roles.

**Requirements**

* Must be competent and efficient with technology. We will train you on the basics of the software we use, but you must have the foundational navigational skills that are universal across most software applications. You must be tech-minded, curious, and comfortable learning new systems quickly.
* Willingness to learn. We are constantly changing, and you need to learn and adapt. The most successful people at Monthend actively seek out feedback and new challenges.
* Be willing to solve problems on your own, but also eager to ask questions to make sure you “get it right”. We value accuracy over speed.
* Completion of a 2-year degree in business, accounting, or related/similar field OR a 4-year degree in any subject. Prior accounting or bookkeeping experience is strongly preferred, as it enables faster growth within the role.
* Must submit to a background check, confidentially processed by a third party.

**What Success Looks Like in the First 6–12 Months**

By the 3–6 month mark, a successful Accounting Analyst will:

* Independently process day-to-day transactions for a defined group of clients with a high level of accuracy.
* Demonstrate strong fluency in Monthend’s technology stack, including QuickBooks Online, Buildertrend, and internal tools.
* Identify common data issues or inconsistencies and resolve them efficiently using established workflows
* Ask thoughtful questions and proactively seek clarification to ensure work is done correctly the first time.
* Consistently meet deadlines and maintain high standards for data quality and documentation.

By the 6–12 month mark, a high-performer will:

* Handle increasingly complex transactions and edge cases with minimal oversight
* Understand how transactional work rolls up into financial statements and client reporting
* Anticipate issues before they become problems and proactively flag them to Associates or Managers
* Begin contributing to process improvements and identifying opportunities to make Monthend’s systems and workflows more efficient
* Demonstrate readiness for expanded responsibility, including deeper client exposure and a path toward senior accounting or advisory roles

**This role is ideal for someone who wants more than repetitive bookkeeping and is excited by the opportunity to grow quickly in responsibility, impact, and career trajectory.**

Pay: $23.00 - $25.00 per hour

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching

* Disability insurance
* Health insurance
* On-the-job training
* Paid time off
* Professional development assistance
* Vision insurance
* Work from home

Education:

* Bachelor's (Required)

Experience:

* Microsoft Excel: 1 year (Preferred)

jobs.title: Virtual Senior Buyer
jobs.description:
In a world of possibilities, pursue one with endless opportunities. Imagine Next!At Parsons, you can imagine a career where you thrive, work with exceptional people, and be yourself. Guided by our leadership vision of valuing people, embracing agility, and fostering growth, we cultivate an innovative culture that empowers you to achieve your full potential. Unleash your talent and redefine what’s possible.

**Job Description:**

**T5 Program Summary: The Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) awarded the Technical Support Services Contract 5 (T5) to Parsons as the prime contractor. This $1.8 billion+ contract has a 4-year base period with two 3-year options. The statement of work includes a variety of activities that support the FAA’s Capital Investment Plan (CIP) modernization efforts: Site selection and engineering, construction, environmental and fire/life safety, equipment installation and testing, CAD, and other technical services as required. Work is performed across the nation and in several U.S. territories. An average staff of 400-500 with a peak staff over 650 supports this contract, in addition to those subcontractors who perform construction work.**

  
  

Parsons is now hiring a Senior Buyer to join our expanding team! Parsons extensive experience combined with your procurement skills will propel your career forward. We need our Buyers at this level to collaborate with technical teams to source materials, equipment, and construction related services nationwide. In this role you will participate in a variety of procurement functions to ensure quality, efficiency, and timeliness of services provided to clients and project personnel. The ideal candidate will have experience supporting construction crews and/or familiarity with construction equipment rentals.

  
  

POSITION OVERVIEW:
  
  
Participates in a wide variety of procurement functions to ensure quality, efficiency, and timeliness of services provided to clients and project personnel. A Senior Buyer understands the entire acquisition life cycle and can independently source requirements from the planning stages through closeout. Specific assignments will vary based on project requirements but will generally involve managing life-cycle acquisitions for material (including via Corporate Purchasing Card (P-card) purchasing), charters, equipment rentals, and professional services. All purchasing activities must be managed and documented in compliance with corporate and federal regulations.
  
  
EDUCATION/EXPERIENCE:
  
  
Some college education is preferred. 3+ years of related work experience is required.
  
  
SKILLS/COMPETENCIES:
  
  
Procurement experience with a major engineering and construction firm or industrial supplier, excellent written and oral communication skills, a working knowledge of PC software packages typically associated with procurement, and proficiency in utilizing basic Microsoft Office products. In addition, a working knowledge of vendor data control, sourcing, expediting, negotiation, and other purchasing activities is required.

  

SPECIFIC RESPONSIBILITIES:

* Sources and establishes subcontractors / vendors. Performs due diligence to qualify and establish them for eligibility to provide material or services.
* Utilizes Corporate Purchasing Card (P-card) to procure goods and services under the micro-purchase threshold in compliance with corporate policies. Records payments and performs timely reconciliations.
* Collaborates with other Procurement representatives and Project Managers in the pre-award solicitation process. Prepares bidders lists, issues Request for Quotations or Request for Proposals, receives and analyzes bids, ensures completeness of bid packages, prepares bid analysis summaries, and makes recommendations for purchase order / subcontract awards.
* Prepares documents and amendments, including identification and inclusion of flowdown requirements from the prime contract. Ensures that terms and conditions will be appropriate.
* Ensures compliance with Parsons and FAA Acquisition Management System (AMS) requirements, and maintains documentation evidencing compliance.
* Prepares and awards Purchase Orders or Subcontracts commensurate with delegated procurement authority.
* Monitors bid requests, bid analyses, and the preparation of purchase orders to ensure timely action.
* Serves as primary point of contact with vendors to ensure equipment and materials are delivered to job sites in support of project schedules, and follows up on assigned purchase orders to ensure adherence to terms and conditions.
* Initiates action, as required, to resolve any supplier problems which might adversely affect project requirements and construction schedules.
* Prepares reports and contractual correspondence. Maintains accurate tracking records tailored to the assigned subcontracts / purchase orders.
* Maintains real-time file documentation, including history of follow-up contact with suppliers.
* Oversees post-award activities such as obtaining final vendor data and invoices, ensuring data is recorded for vendor performance evaluations, and preparing for closeout and storage of all records.
* Performs subcontract / purchase orders closeout actions, completes file documentation, and submits closeout files to storage.
* Serves as primary contact for purchasing support to project management, engineering, and other non-procurement disciplines within assigned regions.
* May analyze draft purchase requisitions, including reviewing for completeness and accuracy, suggesting possible revisions, and forwarding to project management for further processing.
* Evaluates and coordinates arrangements for the safe, most economical delivery of materials / equipment / personnel by selecting the best available transportation modes, carriers, rates, and routing.
* Oversees the administration and maintenance of large BPAs, coordinating with other Procurement Representatives nationwide.
* Performs other responsibilities

Milani Cosmetics is built on a simple belief: beauty should feel exceptional, every day. For more than two decades, that principle has guided our mission to raise the standard of mass beauty, delivering prestige-quality formulas at accessible prices. Based in Los Angeles, Milani champions inclusivity, self-expression and innovation, with products that are proudly cruelty-free.

Milani has delivered 20 consecutive quarters of growth, rising to become the #7 U.S. mass color cosmetics brand. As an independent beauty company, Milani combines an entrepreneurial mindset with a commitment to innovation, quality and meeting the evolving needs of consumers.

With the ambition to surpass $500 million in annual revenue, Milani is entering an exciting phase of expansion. The company is focused on growing its retail presence with strategic partners, including Target and Ulta Beauty, among others, accelerating growth on Amazon and building its international business in key markets.

Our continued success depends on the people behind the brand. At Milani, every person has the opportunity to make a meaningful impact—bringing ideas to life, working across teams and helping shape what comes next. We value curiosity, collaboration and the drive to turn ideas into results. As we grow, we seek people who take ownership, embrace new challenges and want to grow with us.

What's Inside is Everything!

Position Summary:

Milani Cosmetics is seeking a talented and motivated Senior Financial Analyst, to join our Finance team. Reporting to the Senior Director of Financial Planning & Analysis, this role will drive financial planning, operational analysis, and reporting that support business decisions and profitable growth.

This position will partner closely with Finance, Supply Chain, and Operations to lead Operations and SG&A planning, provide insight into costs, margins, and inventory, and support standard costing and master data integrity. The Senior Financial Analyst, Operations, will translate complex data into actionable insights and strengthen reporting tools and processes.

The mission of the Senior Financial Analyst, Operations, is to provide reliable financial planning, analytical insight, and business partnership that improve visibility into operational performance. This role will help leaders manage spending, inventory, and profitability while strengthening the systems, data, and processes that support a growing organization.

The ideal candidate is highly analytical, proactive, and collaborative, with a strong sense of ownership and a hands-on approach. This individual should be comfortable working through detailed analysis, questioning assumptions, and communicating clear recommendations in a fast-paced, growing organization.

**Responsibilities:**

* Lead annual budgeting and quarterly forecasting for Operations and SG&A, including cost of goods sold, other income and expense, capital expenditures, and inventory; consolidate inputs and maintain accurate planning templates and system data.
* Analyze results against budget, forecast, and prior year, identifying key cost and margin drivers, risks, opportunities, and recommended actions.
* Prepare Monthly Business Review materials and executive reporting on financial results, gross margin, operating expenses, inventory, and operational performance; support board, lender, and audit reporting.
* Partner with Supply Chain, Operations, and other business functions to evaluate spending, product costs, and operational performance and provide financial guidance for business decisions.
* Maintain finished goods standard costs ahead of purchase order launches, analyze cost variances, and support stage-gate reviews and new product and bundle launches; maintain wholesale pricing in Sage 100.
* Partner with the Warehouse on daily cycle counts and annual physical inventory; perform inventory reconciliations and analyze turnover, aging, excess and obsolete inventory, and related reserves.
* Coordinate Material Review Board activity, including inventory disposals and cleanup, and provide reporting that supports inventory accuracy and operational accountability.
* Maintain item master data, UPCs, bills of materials, SKU classifications, and lifecycle status in Sage 100 and related systems, following company procedures and data governance standards.
* Maintain and enhance automated reporting using SQL Server, Power BI, and Power Automate, including recurring inventory, receipts, purchasing, production work ticket, in-transit, warehouse, and supply chain reporting; preserve historical reporting archives.
* Validate data across systems, support testing of system changes and upgrades, and serve as a Finance and Supply Chain resource for troubleshooting Sage 100 and reporting tools.
* Develop financial models and new analytics, improve reporting processes and controls, and conduct ad hoc analysis to support business priorities.

 **Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business, or a related field.
* Minimum 3 years of progressive experience in financial analysis, operations finance, manufacturing, inventory management, or a related field.
* Experience supporting budgeting, forecasting, variance analysis, and management reporting, with demonstrated ownership of recurring deliverables.
* Strong understanding of financial statements and the relationships among costs, inventory, profitability, and cash flow; standard costing, inventory accounting, reserves, excess and obsolete inventory, and scrap.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Power Query, lookups, pivot tables, and financial modeling, and proficiency in PowerPoint.
* Strong systems aptitude and ERP experience, including item masters, bills of materials, and inventory transactions; ability to extract, validate, analyze, and maintain financial and operational data.
* Ability to interpret complex data, understand operational drivers and their financial impact, and translate findings

The Senior Project Accountant supports the Finance Business Partner in providing financial analysis, forecasting support, performance reporting, and operational insights across an assigned Business Unit or region.

This role works closely with the Finance Business Partner, Accounting, and Operations teams to monitor financial performance, evaluate project forecasts, identify financial risks and opportunities, and support informed business decisions.

The Senior Project Accountant assists in translating financial information into meaningful insights, ensuring financial data is accurate, consistent, and actionable. jobs.description:

**Hours:** 9/80 Hybrid Schedule, starting as early as 7:00 AM – 4:45 PM, with every other Friday off

**3 Must-Haves:**

* Bachelor's degree in Emergency Management, Public Administration, Public Policy, Political Science, or a related field, with relevant experience.
* At least 6 years of experience in emergency management, outreach, training, and emergency exercise design, including at least 3 years in government emergency management.
* Hands-on experience developing and facilitating emergency preparedness exercises, including tabletop, functional, and full-scale exercises (EOC/ICP).

**Summary:**

We are seeking an experienced Emergency Preparedness and Exercise Design professional to develop and implement an emergency preparedness program for employees across multiple work environments. This role will focus on employee outreach and training, disaster preparedness, and designing emergency response exercises to evaluate and strengthen organizational readiness.

* Develop and implement a year-round emergency preparedness program for employees across different work environments.
* Create and deliver emergency preparedness outreach, training, and educational activities.
* Design, coordinate, and facilitate emergency response exercises for Emergency Operations Centers (EOC) and Incident Command Posts (ICP).
* Develop and conduct tabletop, functional, and full-scale emergency exercises.
* Design and facilitate Disaster Emergency Evacuation Preparedness (DEEP) drills.
* Coordinate exercises involving internal employees, member agencies, and external emergency response organizations.
* Evaluate exercise outcomes, identify areas for improvement, and recommend enhancements to emergency response plans and procedures.
* Travel to various facilities throughout Southern California, approximately 50% of the time.

* Bachelor's degree in Emergency Management, Public Administration, Public Policy, Political Science, or a related field.
* Master's degree is a plus.
* Minimum of 6 years of relevant experience in emergency management, outreach, training, and exercise design.
* At least 3 years of experience working in government emergency management. Utility emergency management experience is preferred.
* Experience developing and facilitating tabletop, functional, and full-scale emergency exercises.
* Hands-on experience with EOC, ICP, and DEEP exercises.
* Experience coordinating emergency preparedness training and outreach programs.
* Completion of FEMA courses IS-100, IS-200, IS-700, and IS-800.
* Valid California Class C Driver's License.

* CEM (Certified Emergency Manager), AEM (Associate Emergency Manager), or equivalent certification is preferred.
* Completion of ICS-300 and ICS-400 is desirable but not required.
* Must be authorized to work in the U.S. without current or future employer-sponsored visa requirements.

Pay: $58.00 - $63.00 per hour

Expected hours: 40.0 per week

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Global Buyer & Planner
jobs.description:
**About Vital Lyfe**

Vital Lyfe is a tech company redefining water autonomy through innovation, creating a new category of personal water making technology built to scale where infrastructure can’t.

**Mission**

We are seeking a proactive and detail oriented Buyer/Planner to manage sourcing, planning, and procurement across new product introductions and ongoing production. This role is central to ensuring continuity of supply, optimizing cost, quality, and delivery, and driving collaboration across engineering, supply chain, and production teams. The ideal candidate combines technical acumen with strong supplier management and planning expertise.

**What You'll Do**

**Planning & Procurement**

* Develop and execute inventory strategies that align with business and production goals, tracking metrics and results end-to-end.
* Maintain accurate configurations (BOMs), lead times, and inventory levels (including spares) to prevent production shortages.
* Place and manage purchase orders (MRP-driven and ad-hoc), resolving discrepancies and invoice issues as needed.
* Support logistics optimization, redistribution policies for assigned parts.

**Supplier Management & Sourcing**

* Build and maintain a robust supply base (domestic and international), ensuring capability, capacity, and financial health.
* Negotiate contracts, RFIs, RFPs, and RFQs, ensuring continuity of supply and competitive costs.
* Partner with suppliers to develop cost management strategies, drive performance improvements, and mitigate sole/single source risks.
* Conduct supplier visits and assessments to validate equipment, technical expertise, and quality systems.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Act as the primary interface between engineering, production, supply chain, and reliability teams for sourcing and planning decisions.
* Support design-for-manufacturability reviews, trade studies, and should-cost modeling with engineering and supplier quality teams.
* Lead cross-functional initiatives to optimize sourcing strategies, improve supplier performance, and adopt low-cost/low-risk parts.
* Provide status updates to leadership and proactively communicate critical supply issues.

**Risk & Performance Management**

* Perform risk analysis incorporating historical supplier performance, demand/supply balance, and lead time analysis.
* Drive value engineering initiatives to improve part quality and reduce costs.
* Monitor global industry trends and supplier technology roadmaps, identifying and mitigating potential supply chain risks.
* Manage costs to align with program budgets and present value propositions and cost strategies to executives.

**What We're Looking For**

* Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Business, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience).
* 4+ years experience in procurement, planning, and supplier management in a production/manufacturing environment.
* Strong negotiation, contract management, and cost analysis skills.
* Familiarity with BOM management, MRP systems, and supply chain risk assessment.
* Excellent cross functional communication and project management skills.
* Ability to travel for supplier visits and assessments.

**Why Join Vital Lyfe?**

* Work on high impact problems with global relevance
* Help scale breakthrough technology in water security and climate resilience
* Early ownership in a high growth, engineering led startup
* Join a tight knit, mission driven team in a fast paced environment
* Build long term career equity as we grow

Location Requirement: Ability to work 100% onsite in Torrance, CA (remote or hybrid work will not be considered)

Vital Lyfe is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with Vital Lyfe is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status.

Compensation Range: $105K - $127K

jobs.title: Financial Analyst, Business Development & Growth
jobs.description:
Millennium Physician Group is one of the largest comprehensive primary care practices in Florida, serving communities through a value-based care model focused on improving patient outcomes and enhancing the healthcare experience. As part of Mosaic Health, MPG is committed to delivering coordinated, patient-centered care while partnering with health plans, providers, and community organizations to improve the health of the populations it serves.

‎ ‎

**Job Description Summary**

Millennium Physician Group is seeking a Financial Analyst to support growth initiatives across mergers and acquisitions, partnerships, and organic growth. This role combines financial modeling, performance analysis, and growth reporting to support business decisions.  
  
The Financial Analyst will support the M&A and partnership evaluation process by collecting data from prospective groups and partners, coordinating due diligence, and preparing financial pro formas. The role will also evaluate organic growth opportunities within existing locations, and own recurring reporting on Growth team KPIs and performance. The analyst will provide ad hoc analysis and collaborate with Business Development, Recruiting, Integrations, Information Technology, Value Based Care, and other teams across MPG.

‎

**How will you make an impact & Requirements**

‎

* Bachelor’s Degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics or Related Degree
* 0-2 years of work experience in healthcare (audit, consulting, or a healthcare quantitative field)
* Previous Microsoft Excel modeling experience is required
* Technical know-how is essential
* Experience with SQL is preferred

**Responsibilities**

  

* Partner with prospects to obtain all due diligence information including pulling data from practice management systems/financial systems when necessary
* Prepare preliminary financial models for acquisition targets

------------

Intuit is a global technology platform that helps consumers and small businesses overcome their most important financial challenges. Serving more than 100 million customers worldwide, we believe that everyone should have the opportunity to prosper. We never stop working to find new, innovative ways to make that possible.

The Global Business Solutions Group (“GBSG”) is Intuit’s largest business unit, serving millions of customers with the QuickBooks line of products including accounting, payments, payroll, capital lending, and banking. QBO Free and the broader low-end lineup (LEL) are central to GBSG’s customer acquisition and growth strategy, and the LEL Finance lead partners closely with Product, Channel, and Analytics leaders to shape that strategy.

Come join Intuit as a Staff Financial Analyst supporting QBO Free and the low-end lineup. This is a highly matrixed, business-partnership role: you will own the economics and the point of view on LEL’s acquisition and freemium funnel, and your influence will come from the quality of your analysis and your ability to bring Product, Channel, Business Operations, and Analytics partners to a shared answer. Financial modeling and reporting are tools you use to earn that influence, not the end deliverable.

**Responsibilities**

* Business partnership & influencing: Serve as the lead finance partner across Product, Channel, Business Operations, and Analytics teams on all things QBO LEL, operating in a highly matrixed organization and driving alignment across functional partners without direct authority over their budgets.
* Freemium funnel economics: Act as the financial source of truth for QBO Free/freemium funnel performance — activation, conversion, retention and churn, attach, and ARPC — partnering with Analytics on acquisitions, churn, and freemium conversion reporting, and act as the subject matter expert in order to provide Finance leadership with a shared, trusted view of performance.
* Channel & acquisition partnership: Partner with channel teams on acquisition forecasting and with Business Operations (Commercial, Product) on in-year planning and long-range planning, translating performance trends into concrete recommendations for Product and Channel leadership.
* Strategic & scenario analysis: Lead trend and scenario analysis to inform strategies to enable durable customer growth,, bringing a point of view rather than just the numbers.
* Financial modeling & forecasting: Maintain the LEL financial model for forecast and close deliverables, support price-increase analysis applicable to LEL, and contribute LEL-specific inputs to broader trend/analytics deliverables for quarter-end, Investor Relations and Board narratives, and long-range planning.

**Qualifications**

* Undergrad in Finance, Accounting, Business Management, or equivalent work experience; Masters in Finance a plus
* 5-7 years of experience in FP&A, strategic finance, or a related analytical role, with demonstrated success partnering directly with Product, Marketing, or Data Science leaders
* Strong track record of influencing decisions through data and storytelling, not just producing reports — comfortable being the finance voice in a room of non-Finance stakeholders and driving alignment without direct authority
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with proven ability to build trust and influence senior, non-finance stakeholders across all levels of the organization
* Comfortable operating with ambiguity in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment; self-starter who can initiate and drive analysis with minimal supervision
* Solid financial modeling and analytical skills (Excel, PowerPoint, Google Suite); experience with BI/reporting tools (Tableau, GitHub, Hyperion) a plus — modeling is in service of partnership and influence, not the primary focus of the role
* Grace under pressure with a good sense of humor and a dose of humility

**Nice to Have**
----------------

* Working fluency in freemium/subscription funnel economics — activation, conversion, retention and churn, attach rate, ARPC, payback
* Experience with freemium, acquisition, or low-end/entry-level product strategy a strong plus

Intuit provides a competitive compensation package with a strong pay for performance rewards approach. This position may be eligible for a cash bonus, equity rewards and benefits, in accordance with our applicable plans and programs (see more about our compensation and benefits at Intuit®: Careers | Benefits). Pay offered is based on factors such as job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and work location. To drive ongoing fair pay for employees, Intuit conducts regular comparisons across categories of ethnicity and gender.

The expected base pay range for this position is:
  
Mountain View $154,000 - $208,500

jobs.title: Associate, Corporate FP&A
jobs.description:
At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next.

  
  

The Corporate Financial Planning and Analysis (‘FP&A’) team at Netflix is responsible for company-wide financial planning, forecasting, and strategic analysis. Financial planning at Netflix spans teams that are functionally aligned (e.g., a Content planning team focused on Content planning/forecasting, a Marketing planning team focused on Marketing, and so on). The Corporate FP&A team partners closely with all of these teams, among others, to create a comprehensive consolidated financial and operational outlook and plays a key role in developing analyses and reports for senior leadership to understand how the company is performing at the global consolidated level.

  
  

Corporate FP&A is entering its next phase. We’re investing in the team, modernizing how we model, reconcile, and report, and scaling the way we work. We’re looking for Associates who want to help build it. You’ll sit at the center of the planning, forecasting, and reporting cycle, work alongside Managers and the Senior Manager, and see how the consolidated picture of the company comes together. You’ll own real pieces of the work from day one, with direct visibility to senior finance leadership and the chance to contribute to how Netflix plans. The position is based in our corporate headquarters in Los Gatos and reports to the Senior Manager of Corporate FP&A.

  
  

**Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:**
-----------------------------------------------------

* **P&L & Forecast Support** : You’ll learn the P&L from the inside. Help maintain the consolidated P&L, forecast reconciliations, and the mapping and hierarchies behind them. You’ll build a deep understanding of what drives the business and help explain how it’s performing against forecast and plan. The numbers you maintain are the foundation for every downstream deliverable, so accuracy and rigor are central to the role.
* **Planning Process Support** : You’ll help keep Netflix’s planning cycle on track. Support the planning calendar, mid-quarter and pre-close checkpoints, and long-range planning materials. You’ll see how decisions take shape across Content, Product, Marketing, and the rest of the company.
* **Management Reporting** : You’ll help tell the company’s financial story. Help build the decks, memos, and reporting hubs that support the CFO, the Board, and senior leadership, and help turn them into reusable templates that make every cycle sharper.
* **Partnership** : You’ll become a connector across Finance. Build relationships with functional finance teams, Accounting, and Revenue Analytics, learn the context behind their numbers, and help bring it together into one clear view.
* **Shaping What’s Next** : You’ll help the team get smarter every cycle. Bring ideas, and own real projects, that automate our work, document what we know, and bring AI into how we plan, forecast, and report. What you build becomes part of how the team works.
  

  

**Qualifications**
------------------

* 3+ years of experience in FP&A, Strategic Finance, Accounting, or a related analytical role
* Strong quantitative and financial analysis skills with close attention to detail
* Working knowledge of key accounting concepts; experience with financial planning tools (e.g., TM1, Anaplan, Looker, etc.) a plus
* Extremely proficient with spreadsheets and slides
* Clear written and verbal communication
* Natural talent for systems and design thinking; ability to map workflows, identify bottlenecks, and redesign scalable processes from first principles
* Curiosity in AI and automation frameworks; practical experience with capturing and leveraging context at scale, and low-code tools to extract insights and automate workflows
* Bachelor’s Degree
  

  
Generally, our compensation structure consists solely of an annual salary; we do not have bonuses. You choose each year how much of your compensation you want in salary versus stock options. To determine your personal top of market compensation, we rely on market indicators and consider your specific job family, background, skills, and experience to determine your compensation in the market range. The range for this role is $155,000.00 - $235,000.00.

Netflix provides comprehensive benefits including Health Plans, Mental Health support, a 401(k) Retirement Plan with employer match, Stock Option Program, Disability Programs, Health Savings and Flexible Spending Accounts, Family-forming benefits, and Life and Serious Injury Benefits. We also offer paid leave of absence programs. Full-time hourly employees accrue 35 days annually for paid time off to be used for vacation, holidays, and sick paid time off. Full-time salaried employees are immediately entitled to flexible time off. See more details about our Benefits here .

jobs.title: Security Compliance Analyst
jobs.description:
Our client, a global technology and financial services company, is seeking a **Security Compliance Analyst** to provide hands-on administrative and program management support for Security Compliance for approximately 6 months, with the possibility of an extension based on business needs or increased workload. The person will keep recurring reviews, audits, testing engagements, and customer security requests moving according to schedule so Security Compliance specialists can focus on assessment, technical interpretation, and remediation efforts. The analyst will work with Security Compliance program owners and relevant cross-functional stakeholders under a defined intake and escalation process.

This is a **remote 6-month contract position.** Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States. No H-1B visa sponsorship available. Hourly rate: **$87.54. No C2C.**

**Responsibilities**

**Third-Party Security Questionnaire Intake and Response:** Monitor assigned customer security questionnaires, document-request queues, and relevant channel requests; acknowledge and categorize requests, identify DRIs and due dates, and route requesters to approved self-service materials where appropriate. Use the team’s questionnaire tool to generate draft responses, then validate them for completeness, accuracy, and consistency with approved security documentation. Track DRI input and assemble approved artifacts. Initially, a Security Compliance employee will review the completed responses and approve delivery. After training and demonstrated accuracy, the contractor may independently review and deliver routine questionnaires within an agreed-upon, documented scope. Escalate bespoke questions, uncertain or outdated answers, new security assertions, non-public disclosures, blockers, and deadlines to the appropriate Security Compliance employee or team DRI before delivery.

**Quarterly Security Operational Reviews:** Maintain the quarter-by-quarter calendar, control and evidence request lists, templates, status trackers, evidence links, and follow-up logs. Collect evidence from control owners, identify missing or late submissions, prepare review packets, draft administrative portions of reports, and track Security Compliance/PCI DRI reviews and approvals. The Security Compliance reviewer remains responsible for examining evidence, documenting substantive conclusions, and verifying PCI DSS business-as-usual requirements.

**Audit and Penetration Testing Logistics:** Maintain audit and testing calendars, evidence and request trackers, and action logs. Schedule walkthroughs from program-owner-approved attendee and scope lists. Coordinate vendor meetings, access requests through approved channels, evidence deadlines, and follow-ups. Maintain a clear record of what was requested, provided, reviewed, and remains outstanding. Program owners retain responsibility for audit scope, firm selection, SOW approval, findings, and responses.

**Operational Reporting and Handoff:** Produce a concise weekly summary of open requests, aged items, upcoming milestones, unresolved decisions, and escalations. Document repeatable playbooks, templates, owners, and evidence locations to enable a seamless handoff at the end of the contract.

**Skills**

* Experience coordinating security compliance activities, audits, compliance operations, or customer security questionnaires.
* Strong written communication skills, discretion when handling confidential information, strong program and project management skills, general security knowledge, organized tracking and follow-through, and the ability to coordinate across multiple teams and external parties.
* Familiarity with PCI DSS, SOC 1/SOC 2, and/or ISO 27001, audit evidence, and security questionnaires is preferred but not required.
* The role requires reliable execution, sound judgment regarding escalations, and coordination with employee owners for compliance-related determinations.

**Decision and Access Boundaries:**

Security Compliance employees own control interpretation, evidence acceptance, substantive review findings, new customer-facing security assertions, non-routine disclosure decisions, and attestations. Following training and authorization, the contractor may review and deliver routine questionnaire responses within the agreed scope. Employee DRIs review exceptions before delivery. Client employees own purchase orders and vendor invoice approvals.

BS/MS degree or equivalent relevant experience.

EVgo (Nasdaq: EVGO) is one of the nation’s largest public fast charging networks for electric vehicles. Our mission is to build a sustainable business that powers our transportation and protects our planet. As a leader in clean transportation, EVgo sits at the intersection of technology, infrastructure, and innovation.

We are rapidly expanding our national footprint through strategic partnerships with retailers, automakers, rideshare and, fleets, bringing fast charging to communities across the country. EVgo enables drivers of all makes and models to charge where they want, when they want.

The Energy Management Analyst II plays a critical role in protecting and improving the cost of powering EVgo’s charging network. Serving as the day-to-day point of contact for utility account and billing matters, the role follows each request from intake through resolution and cash recovery. * Partner with Operations and Grid Integration to resolve issues quickly and track each through to resolution.

* Report on recoveries, savings and program status to Finance and leadership.

**About Santa Monica Seafood**
------------------------------

Founded in 1939, Santa Monica Seafood is a family-owned business that has grown into the largest seafood-only distributor in the Southwestern United States, serving foodservice and retail customers through an extensive network of processing and distribution facilities. Our reputation is built on an unwavering commitment to product quality, food safety, responsible sourcing, and exceptional customer service.

This highly visible Senior Buyer position offers an experienced procurement professional the opportunity to make a meaningful impact across the organization by strengthening supplier partnerships, leveraging our purchasing scale, and driving measurable improvements in cost, efficiency, and operational performance.

**Position Summary**

We are seeking an experienced Senior Buyer – Packaging & Indirect Materials to lead strategic sourcing, supplier negotiations, and procurement activities for packaging, personal protective equipment (PPE), maintenance, repair and operating (MRO) supplies, and other indirect materials across our operations.

This position will play a key role in consolidating purchasing activities across company locations, leveraging our collective buying power, reducing costs, and ensuring reliable supply to support our production and distribution operations.

The ideal candidate combines strong negotiation and analytical skills with hands-on procurement experience and a demonstrated ability to deliver measurable cost savings while maintaining quality, service, and supply continuity.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**
-----------------------------------------

-----------------------------------------------

**Cost Optimization & Purchasing Efficiency**

* Maintain accurate purchasing documentation, contracts, and supplier records.

**Reporting & Analytics**
-------------------------

* Prepare purchasing reports, supplier scorecards, spend analyses, and savings summaries.

**FP&A Analyst – Urban Golf Performance (UGP)**
===============================================

**About UGP**
-------------

Urban Golf Performance (UGP) delivers the most comprehensive golf learning experience in the game. From Tour level coaching and golf specific fitness to recovery, custom club fitting, and expert club building, we help PGA and LPGA Tour pros, NCAA champions, elite amateurs, club competitors, and beginners achieve the best golf and health of their lives.

**About the Role**
------------------

We're looking for an FP&A Analyst to be the financial backbone behind UGP's growth decisions. Reporting to the Chief Business Officer, you'll build the models, forecasts, and reporting that help leadership understand performance across every UGP service line and location, and decide where to invest next.

* **Reports to:** Chief Business Officer
* **Location:** Based at our corporate office in Irvine, California, with regular travel to all UGP Southern California locations. Candidates must live in or be willing to relocate to California
* **Compensation:** $65,000 to $80,000 per year, depending on experience

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Build and maintain the annual budget, rolling forecasts, and long-range financial plans in partnership with the Chief Business Officer and department leaders
* Develop and own financial models for new locations, new service lines, pricing changes, and major investments
* Prepare monthly management reporting, including P&L, budget-to-actual variance analysis, and clear commentary on key drivers
* Analyze performance by location and service line (coaching, fitness, recovery, club fitting, club building, and retail), including revenue, margin, utilization, and membership trends
* Track and report key business metrics such as CAC, LTV, retention, and revenue per client, partnering with marketing and operations
* Build dashboards and reporting tools that give leadership timely, accurate visibility into the business
* Partner with accounting to ensure month-end close data is accurate and to reconcile forecasts to actuals
* Support cash flow forecasting, capital planning, and unit economics analysis
* Prepare financial materials for leadership, board, lender, and investor discussions
* Conduct ad hoc analyses to support strategic decisions and translate findings into clear, actionable recommendations
* Identify opportunities to improve financial processes, data quality, and reporting efficiency

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

* Golf industry knowledge or enthusiasm is a plus!
* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business, or a related field
* 0 to 3 years of experience in FP&A, corporate finance, accounting, investment banking, or consulting. Strong entry-level candidates, including those with relevant internships, are encouraged to apply
* Advanced Excel or Google Sheets skills, including financial modeling, pivot tables, and complex formulas
* Solid understanding of financial statements, budgeting, forecasting, and variance analysis
* Experience with accounting and reporting tools (e.g., QuickBooks) and BI or dashboard tools (e.g., Metabase, Looker, Tableau) is a plus
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to turn data into clear insights and recommendations
* Excellent communication skills, comfortable presenting financial findings to executives and non-finance partners
* Exceptional attention to detail and a commitment to accuracy and confidentiality
* Organized, self-motivated, and comfortable managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced, multi-location environment
* Experience in multi-location retail, fitness, hospitality, or consumer services is a plus
* Must currently live in the United States; candidates already living in California are strongly preferred. Ability to work on-site in Irvine and travel regularly to UGP's Southern California locations

**Why UGP**
-----------

UGP has 6 locations today and a plan to grow to 40+. This is an early finance hire at a company in that kind of growth phase, so you'll work directly with senior leadership, see how your analysis shapes real decisions, and get exposure to every part of the business.

**Where this role can go:** As UGP scales, so does the finance function. This role is built to grow with it: from analyst, to owning more of our planning and reporting, to leading the finance department. For someone who performs at a high level, the long-term path leads to CFO.

When you apply, please begin your answer to the "Why UGP?" question with the word "Birdie."

**Location requirement:** Candidates must currently live in the United States. Candidates already living in California are strongly preferred.

----------------

* Dental Insurance

* Paid Time Off
* Parental Leave
* 401(k) Retirement Savings Plan
* Employer Matching for 401(k) Contributions

jobs.description:
**Who We Are**

  

At OluKai, we build premium products for the ocean lifestyle. Our footwear is created using the highest quality materials and crafted into beautiful, functional and incredibly comfortable designs that reflect the spirit of the ocean lifestyle we all enjoy.  
  
We are committed to creating quality products for our customers while leaving the smallest footprint possible on the planet. Our company philosophy is to be environmentally responsible as manufacturers and to pledge OluKai to actively support and work for a clean environment and a better quality of life.  
  
Our customers and staff embody the connection that exists between people and the ocean, it is our Culture. We want to build a team of individuals who embrace this culture and have a passion for providing premium products and service to our customers.

**About the Role**

As our Senior Buyer for Amazon, you own the buy for our Amazon business. You’ll build the monthly revenue and inventory plans for Amazon US and Canada, turn them into accurate buys, and keep the business in stock without tying up cash in excess. You’ll work closely with Finance, Product & Planning, Sales, and our agency and media partners, and you’ll report on how we’re tracking to executives every week.

This is a hands-on role for someone who is as comfortable in a forecast model as they are in a conversation with an Amazon account manager.

**What You’ll Do (Responsibilities include, but are not limited to)**

**Plan the Business**

Partner with the CRO and SVP of Finance to build a monthly plan for Amazon Business in both the US and Canada, including:

* Gross and net sales
* Unit sales and unit inventory
* Return units and dollars
* Media spend
* Opex

  

**Buy the Inventory**

* Forecast and size the total units needed each month by gender, category, style, color, and size.
* Decide the right mix across the full line, special makeups, rebuys, and distressed inventory.
* Work with Product & Planning to procure inventory, and hit every deadline on the buying and procurement calendar.
* Buy accurately, so we support growth with little to no excess or overbuy.
* Work with the broader Sales team to place inventory where it will perform best.
* Complete Business Unit Roll-ups as needed so Planning can build accurate company-wide inventory forecasts.

  

**Keep the Channel Running**

* Place replenishment orders based on demand: typically, twice a week in high season and once a week in shoulder months.
* **Agency partners:** attend the standing weekly status meeting and set priorities for the week.
* **Media partner:** run a monthly push/pull list, hold ad hoc meetings in high season, and give clear direction on spend.
* **Amazon Strategic Account Services (SAS) manager:** meet weekly to keep the Amazon storefront healthy, escalate issues, and pursue marketing placement and other extras the relationship can unlock.
* **OluKai Ecom & Operations:** partner to use Buy with Prime (BWP) at strategic selling moments.

  

**Report and Recommend**

* Present at the monthly Hindsight meetings with Product & Planning.
* Send a weekly recap to the executive team on performance and progress toward monthly and annual revenue goals.
* Present seasonal reporting twice a year at our Demand meetings, covering overall strategy and the buys placed by style and category.

  

**Experience and Qualifications**

**Required**

* 5–7 years of buying or planning experience, ideally in e-commerce or consumer products.
* Strong Excel skills, including building and maintaining forecast models.
* Comfort working across Finance, Product, Sales, and outside partners.
* Sound judgment on how much to buy, and the discipline to hit buying calendar deadlines.

  

**Nice to Have**

* Experience with Amazon Seller Central, Helium 10, Jungle Scout, or Amazon media.
* Experience with Full Circle or Domo.
* Footwear or apparel buying experience.

  

**Core Competencies and Success Measures**

* Plan accuracy: actual sales, units, and returns tracking to the monthly plan.
* Healthy inventory: strong in-stock rates with limited excess and aged inventory.
* On-time buys: every order placed according to the procurement calendar.
* Clear communication: reliable weekly and monthly reporting that leaders can act on.

  

**Location & Office Structure:** This is an in-office hybrid position, mandatory 4 days per week in office in Irvine, CA with the option to work from home 1 day per week. Subject to change without notice as per company guidelines.

  

**Compensation:** The salary range for this position is $1110,000 - $140,000 plus opportunity for annual bonus; salary is based on the experience that you bring to the position.

**Benefits and Perks:**

* Complimentary chef prepared breakfast and lunch provided Monday - Thursday
* Generous product gift program and all brand discounts

* Medical, Dental, Vision insurance in accordance with plan guidelines

* Work with talented and great people who share a love of the ocean lifestyle

Targetti USA is a leading provider of high-quality architectural lighting solutions, offering Italian design and innovation tailored for the North American market. As a growing company, we’re looking for talented individuals who want to grow with us and help shape inspiring spaces through light.

The Buyer supports purchasing and material availability by processing purchase orders, coordinating supplier deliveries, and maintaining accurate purchasing and material information in SAP. This role works closely with vendors and internal teams to resolve supply issues, communicate delivery timelines, and help ensure materials are available to meet production and customer needs.

The position also supports vendor evaluation, logistics coordination, material costing, and the creation and maintenance of part numbers, bills of materials (BOMs), and production routings in collaboration with teams in the USA and Italy.

* Create and issue purchase orders in SAP for approved purchases, including outside processing services.

* Obtain vendor order confirmations, lead times, estimated ship dates (ESDs), and delivery commitments.

* Monitor open purchase orders, follow up on outstanding items, and expedite deliveries as needed to support operational priorities.

* Request and review vendor quotes, proposals, and capabilities to support purchasing decisions.

* Work with the Operations Manager and Production team to align purchasing and supplier deliveries with production schedules.

* Monitor material availability and communicate issues that may affect scheduled orders.

* Provide backup support for production coordination and ESD scheduling.

**Administrative & Financial Support**  

* Process purchasing orders and maintain accurate supporting records.

* Submit payment requests and related documentation to Accounting.

* Coordinate with vendors and internal teams to resolve purchasing documentation or payment questions.

**Training & Cross-Functional Support**  

* Cross-train current and new team members on purchasing processes and assigned duties to maintain coverage and consistency.

* Support purchasing, logistics, and production workflows during absences, urgent operational needs, or changes in workload.

* Complete additional assignments and special projects as business needs evolve.

* Three or more years of experience in purchasing, procurement, or a closely related supply chain role.

* Experience in a manufacturing or assembly environment preferred.

* Hands-on experience using an ERP system to create purchase orders, track deliveries, and maintain purchasing or material records; SAP experience strongly preferred.

* Working knowledge of MRP and how purchasing, inventory, and supplier lead times affect production requirements.

* Experience purchasing from and working directly with suppliers in Asian markets, including coordinating lead times, production updates, and international shipments.

* Experience following up with suppliers, reviewing quotes, and coordinating deliveries.

* Familiarity with BOMs, part numbers, production routings, and material costing; experience creating or maintaining these records preferred.

* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including formulas, sorting, filtering, and reviewing purchasing or material data.

* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to maintain accurate records and manage multiple open orders.

* Clear communication skills and the ability to work effectively with vendors and teams across departments and locations.

* Ability to adapt to changing priorities and balance routine purchasing responsibilities with urgent operational needs.

jobs.description:
**The Position**
----------------

*The City of Oakland is an equal opportunity employer that values workforce diversity, inclusion, and equity. Oakland has a long history of activism around issues of justice and equity. Both oppression and this resistance to oppression have shaped the city’s historical roots and the lives of its residents to this day. As public servants in one of the most diverse cities in the nation, we strive to develop employees who understand the harm and impacts of systemic inequity to create lasting, meaningful outcomes for everyone. Oakland strives to establish an environment that embraces the richness of culture, community, and individualism of employees.*
  
  
**Why join the City of Oakland's Department of Public Works?**

The City of Oakland is recruiting three (3) Program Analyst III (Selective Certification – Watershed) positions in the Watershed and Stormwater Management Division within the Department of Public Works.

The big picture of this work is to:

* Keep pollutants out of stormwater and waterways

* Maintain and improve the health of creeks and watersheds

* Coordinate and implement Citywide compliance with stormwater and creek protection regulations

* Help plan stormwater system rehabilitation and upgrades, including green stormwater infrastructure and creek restoration

* Plan and manage projects and programs

We work on various stormwater pollution prevention programs, green stormwater infrastructure planning and projects, creek protection and restoration, water quality in Lake Merritt and other waterways, environmental review of proposed developments and City projects, investigation of and enforcement against creek violations and illegal pollution discharges to the storm drainage system. Additional program information is posted at www.oaklandca.gov/Community/Community-Development/Sustainability-Environment/Creeks-Watershed-and-Stormwater.

The Watershed Program Specialists work in a cohort of three to four under a unit supervisor. The broader Watershed Division also includes a small team of engineers, a capital improvements project manager, and a division manager. The current team is experienced, motivated, hardworking, and effective.
  
  
**We are looking for someone who is:**

* Passionate about helping the environment, community, and the focus and purpose of our work.
